target_uncertainty: Uncertainty that could materially change the pattern.
evidence_source: Who or what can discriminate between explanations.
collection_action: Specific question, observation, or case to collect.
supporting_result: Result that would strengthen the candidate pattern.
disconfirming_result: Result that would weaken, split, or reject the pattern.
sampling_instruction: Seek a case not selected for enthusiasm toward the proposed solution.
priority_rationale: Why this test has high information value.
